rule.description: An ordered, contiguous group of at least 3 parameter types recurs, in the same order, across at least 5 distinct function signatures (implicit `self` receivers are not parameters); the group travels through the calls as independently named values instead of one cohesive structure.

checks.description: Detect readers of a serialized FST that thread the decode context (format version, raw bytes, node address, and its derived layout factors) as separate parameters instead of one cohesive node/lookup context.
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The version/bytes/address group is one node's decode context; splitting it forces every reader, and every call path into the readers, to know the pieces and repeat the handoff, which is the data-clump relation this case treats as the smell.

matches.evidence: fst_get takes (version: u64, data: &[u8], root_addr: CompiledAddr, key: &[u8]) and walks the raw bytes with the address threaded by hand at src/raw/mod.rs:692.
fst_contains_key repeats the (version, data, root_addr) handoff for a membership walk at src/raw/mod.rs:720.
fst_get_key_into threads (version, data, root_addr, value, key) while descending toward the largest accumulated output at src/raw/mod.rs:741.
fst_empty_final_output decodes the root node through (version, data, root_addr) instead of through a node value at src/raw/mod.rs:774.
The single-transition reader needs only (version ignored, data, start) but the spread forces the caller to supply the version anyway at src/raw/node.rs:395.
StateOneTrans::input repeats the (version, data, start) bundle of its sibling decoder at src/raw/node.rs:474.
StateOneTrans::output carries (version, data, start, sizes) though it reads only data/start/sizes at src/raw/node.rs:483.
StateOneTrans::trans_addr takes the full (version, data, start, end, sizes) decode context as five separate parameters at src/raw/node.rs:503.
The many-transition transition-address decoder threads (version, data, start, end, sizes, ntrans, i) independently at src/raw/node.rs:717.
StateAnyTrans::input declares (version, data, start, end, sizes, ntrans, i) although the end and sizes pieces are unused by it at src/raw/node.rs:740.
StateAnyTrans::find_input carries the same seven-piece context for byte lookup at src/raw/node.rs:760.
StateAnyTrans::output repeats the decode context handoff to read one packed output value at src/raw/node.rs:793.
node_is_final re-derives a node from loose (version, data, addr) values on every call at src/raw/node.rs:970.
node_final_output re-derives the same decode context to read one field at src/raw/node.rs:981.
node_transition_count threads the context trio to answer a size question about one node at src/raw/node.rs:991.
node_transition takes (version, data, addr, i) for a per-transition read at src/raw/node.rs:1001.
node_transition_addr threads the same four loose pieces for the address-only variant at src/raw/node.rs:1012.
node_find_input threads (version, data, addr, b) to locate an input byte at src/raw/node.rs:1024.

checks.description: Detect compile-path functions that pass the contents of a node being serialized (final flag, final output, transition list) as separate parameters instead of one node value.
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: is_final/final_output/trans are the three fields of one serialized node; threading them separately through the compiler, both registries and the serializer is the same recurring-bundle relation seen from the writing side.

matches.evidence: builder_compile_node serializes one node through loose (is_final, final_output, trans) values at src/raw/build.rs:316.
Node::compile dispatches node shape from (is_final, final_output, trans) instead of a node value at src/raw/node.rs:295.
StateAnyTrans::compile writes the many-transition layout from the same three loose pieces at src/raw/node.rs:521.
Registry::entry keys the registry by (is_final, final_output, trans) rather than by a node value at src/raw/registry.rs:36.
Registry::hash folds the same three pieces into the bucket index at src/raw/registry.rs:52.
RegistryCache::entry compares and stores cached nodes field-by-field through the loose bundle at src/raw/registry.rs:77.
reg_node_eq re-implements node equality piecewise because callers arrive with the node already split at src/raw/registry.rs:154.
reg_node_store re-assembles a node field-by-field for every cache write at src/raw/registry.rs:167.
The minimal registry recombines (is_final, final_output, trans) into a node value purely to key its HashMap, mirroring the main registry's split signature at src/raw/registry_minimal.rs:39.

excluded.what: The (writer, last_addr, addr) triple threaded through the builder's free compile steps (builder_compile_node, builder_compile_from, builder_compile_root) recipies only three signatures.
excluded.reason: The rule requires the same group to recur across at least 5 distinct functions; three synchronized signatures are a small helper family, not the recurring bundle this case credits.

excluded.what: The (writer, node_addr, trans_addr, nbytes) and (version, data, sizes, ntrans) groups used by the pack/unpack helpers of the raw format.
excluded.reason: These pre-existing groups recur below the 5-signature threshold (4 for the writer/alpha trio), so the rule does not flag them; they predate the task's refactor.
